MadLean is proud to announce :umbrella_with_rain: Lean Forecast :sunny: with @Juanjo Madrigal!

Juanjo recently updated the v4.30.0 highlights for the Lean reference manual. The Lean forecast will be a 20 minutes quick preview of the cool things to come followed by a deep dive / Q&A working with those features.

We are planning to stream this at 2026-06-10T18:15:00+02:00 over Zoom: https://us05web.zoom.us/j/88985945056.

For more info about MadLean, please go to #Geographic locality > Madrid, Spain or our website: https://madlean-hub.web.app.

Note: we are aware this unfortunately overlaps with #Event announcements > The Meta Café and we apologize for the inconvenience. Unfortunately as MadLean is an in-person event which started in February based on the overlapping availability of the organizers we don't have much flexibility with the time at the moment. :folded_hands:
